fns.desc: wpa_command_resp: len=resp_size before wpa_ctrl_request; if reply exactly fills caller's resp buffer, wpa_ctrl_request sets *reply_len==resp_size (no truncation-by-one applied on this return path, see wpa_ctrl.c wpa_ctrl_request's *reply_len=res;break), then resp[len]='\0' writes 1 byte past the end of the caller-supplied buffer -- identical root cause sqc already caught at wpa_helpers.c:52,181 (wpa_command/get_wpa_status) but missed here and in add_network/add_cred which both call this function.
